title: US Divorce Fell As First Marriage Moved Later
hook: Americans married later while divorce fell nearly by half.
closing: The trends moved together, but they do not prove that waiting caused the divorce decline.
question: How old were your parents when married?

segments.say: The US divorce rate fell to 2.4 per thousand, nearly half its earlier level.
US women now first marry at 28.6, showing marriage timing shifted alongside the divorce decline.
